facts.note: Watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the bell struck nine; uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
Went up to the library and stayed there alone ("I had brandy, alone"); watch showed twenty to ten when the temple struck ten.
Thump in the atelier right above at 10:18 by his watch, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.
At 10:15 someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door; at 10:21 someone came quickly down. He did not see who; the door was shut in both cases.
Aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by his watch and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
